title: 2026中国银行北京马拉松暨全国马拉松锦标赛报名须知
publisher: 北京马拉松赛组织委员会
claims: The 2026 Beijing Marathon and the National Marathon Championships take place on Sunday 18 October 2026, starting at 07:30.
The start is at Tiananmen Square and the finish is on the Landscape Avenue in the Olympic Park central area.
The 2026 field is 32,000 runners across the marathon and the National Marathon Championships, both over 42.195 km.
The course passes through Dongcheng, Xicheng, Haidian and Chaoyang districts.
Runners must be at least 20 years old in the race year; those aged 65 or over must submit a commitment form signed by themselves and a family member.
Entry requires a marathon finish or two half-marathon finishes within the 24 months before the entry deadline; virtual race results are not accepted.
Registration ran from 10:00 on 17 September 2026 to 18:00 on 22 September 2026, with a ballot if demand exceeded the field.
The entry fee was CNY 200 per person, non-refundable, and places were not transferable.
No racing wheelchair category was offered in 2026 and racing wheelchairs were not permitted; non-racing wheelchair athletes started at the back of the field.
Strollers were prohibited from the start, finish and course.
The event is organised by the Chinese Athletics Association and the Beijing Municipal Bureau of Sports, co-organised by China Media Group.
Race-day entry uses bib checks plus face-recognition or identity-document verification.
